notes: Basic keyword, identifier, symbol, and EOF flow.
Keywords should still be recognized even in lowercase or mixed case.
Leading spaces, tabs, and newlines should not break tokenization.
Identifiers may start with underscore and numbers should tokenize cleanly.
Quoted text should become a string literal without quote characters.
Single-character tokens should work even when packed together.
Back-to-back symbol tokens should be returned one by one.
A bad character inside an identifier should produce INVALID instead of an exception.
A number immediately followed by letters should become INVALID.
Missing closing quote should return INVALID.
A completely unsupported character should throw LexerException right away.
No tokens other than EOF should be returned for empty input.
